title: GOAL: Adaptive Planner Routing — evidence-driven Planner model routing (Opus default candidate, Fable escalation) with telemetry, taxonomy, deterministic elimination, compact packets, shadow mode, Planner scorecard, promotion, usage protection; brief .orchestrator/planner-routing-program.md
spec: Replace the static Planner = Fable assumption in the headless decision path with an evidence-driven router: L0 deterministic daemon → L1 taxonomy and deterministic routes → L2 Opus Planner (default candidate, shadow first) → L3 Fable escalation; downstream outcomes feed a Planner scorecard that decides promotion per decision class. Fable-only behaviour remains available (mode off) and is the quality baseline; shadow is the default; active never flips without evidence. Hard-Fable decisions hold with a visible reason when Fable is unavailable. Brief: .orchestrator/planner-routing-program.md. Plan and decomposition: .orchestrator/plan.md.
acceptance: Every new module ships with tests/test_<module>.py and the external gate .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh passes on goal/<this id>

pool.toml [planner.routing] mode off reproduces today's launch argv and tier selection byte for byte (tests/test_planner_runs.py); mode shadow leaves production tier unchanged while recording an Opus shadow decision that cannot mutate the bus; mode active is possible but stays off in pool.toml
orchestrator scorecard --planner-routing and orchestrator promotion report the Planner scorecard per model × decision type × band × class and a stay/promote/demote recommendation for planner_routing
A Fable-only baseline (label planner-fable-only) is saved with baseline.save before any routing mode other than off runs live, and PR goal/<this id> -> main is opened for the human
